verdict.rationale: Maritime's SDK documents a single idempotent `provision` call that creates a per-user agent, and each agent runs in its own micro-VM with secrets injected only into that VM, so one-call isolated provisioning is the product's own capability. Nothing shows the environment is live in seconds: the only timing claim is a whole quickstart 'in under 5 minutes', and no provisioning latency is documented. missing for 10: documented seconds-level time-to-live for provisioned environments, an explicit isolation model for the sandbox, independent or hands-on corroboration of provisioning speed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up an isolated sandbox with one API/SDK call and get a live environment in seconds
